scripts.prepare:sidecar: cargo build --locked -p hydra-runtime && node tools/tauri/stage-sidecar.mjs debug
scripts.prepare:sidecar:release: cargo build --locked --release -p hydra-runtime && node tools/tauri/stage-sidecar.mjs release
scripts.tauri: npm run prepare:sidecar && sh tools/tauri/with-macos-signing tauri
scripts.build: npm run prepare:sidecar:release && sh tools/tauri/with-macos-signing tauri build
